ECHO Benchmark
	

This repository contains the dataset accompanying the paper Constantly Improving Image Models Need Constantly Improving Benchmarks.

Project page: https://echo-bench.github.io/
Code: https://github.com/para-lost/ECHO

For any questions or inquiries, please contact us at echo-bench@googlegroups.com.


	
		
	
	
		About the Dataset
	

ECHO stands for Extracting Community Hatched Observations. ECHO is a framework for constructing benchmarks directly from social media… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/echo-bench/echo2025.
reputation: Emerging benchmark introduced with a paper on continual improvement of image models; interest is growing among vision and robustness researchers but broad adoption is still limited.
